## Nebius Group files mid-period financial review citing AI cloud-driven growth

Nebius's voluntary mid-period update is a rare readout on AI infrastructure demand broadening beyond the hyperscalers; its trajectory is a cross-check on whether AI build-out is becoming a global phenomenon or remains concentrated.

- NBIS filed a financial review covering the mid-2025/2026 period with an investor update.
- AI cloud demand is cited as the primary growth driver in the filing.
- The disclosure provides an independent scaling data point outside the major U.S. hyperscaler cohort, per classifier context.
- Nebius is categorized under sovereign AI deployments, reflecting its non-hyperscaler positioning.
